title: Status shows as a color-coded badge whose label text is always present (color is never the only signal)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The report shows work orders in several statuses (Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Review, Complete).
custom_steps:
1. Read the Status column across rows in each tab.
2. Compare each badge's color against the application's standard status colors used elsewhere.
custom_expected:
1. Status is shown as a badge using the status's label: "Estimate", "Approved", "In Progress", "Review", or "Complete".
2. The badge is color-coded per the application's standard status colors.
3. The label text is always present, so color is never the sole signal of the status.
